In this installment, Dan and Jordan find Alex in the aftermath of having not saved Gene Hackman, as he tries to play defense for Pam Bondi's failed PR stunt and has a mental orgasm over Trump being mean to Zelensky.

==Tidbits==

* Alex says it's the most important broadcast he's ever done. Again.
* Alex claims "full-spectrum" understanding, having scanned everything since 3am.
* Alex: Trump is performing at 1,000%.
* The deep state is in a massive civil war with Trump, and reaching a climax.
* Alex believes [[Pam Bondi]] was set up regarding the Epstein files release.
* Trump is ending the Ukraine war, and calling Zelensky a clown to his face.
* Alex claims James Comey's daughter has run all of the Jeffrey Epstein prosecutions and operations out of New York.
* Alex claims Epstein evidence went missing under [[Maureen Comey|Maureen Comey's]] watch. Implies it disappeared from FBI custody. (It didn't.)
* Alex turns to Zelensky visit: Zelensky is "melting down" and Trump is "spanking" him.
* Alex: Zelensky is "a little lying, corrupt, cokehead weasel."
* Alex calls the Trump/Zelensky exchange "the coolest thing I've ever seen in my life."
* Alex: "I just had the biggest mental orgasm of my life."
* Alex: "This is what they must have felt like when the Death Star blew up."
* Alex performs his version of that scene from When Harry Met Sally. He's a terrible actor.
* Alex 'interviews' the Daily Caller's 'Edgar' puppet; it's painfully awful.
